sentences.zh: 陪审团是否已对起诉书中的每一项指控达成裁决？

sentences.en: Yes, we have.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们达成了。

sentences.en: One verdict and one verdict?
sentences.zh: 是一项裁决还是一份裁决？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: As to the first count of the information, we the jury find the defendant,
sentences.zh: 关于起诉书的第一项指控，我们陪审团裁定被告，

sentences.en: Kyle H.
sentences.zh: 凯尔·H·

sentences.en: Rittenhouse, not guilty.
sentences.zh: 里滕豪斯，无罪。

sentences.en: As to the second count of the information, the third count of the fourth count of the information, as to the fifth count of the information, we the jury find the defendant, Kyle H.
sentences.zh: 关于起诉书的第二项、第三项、第四项指控，以及关于起诉书的第五项指控，我们陪审团裁定被告，凯尔·H·

sentences.en: Rittenhouse, not guilty.
sentences.zh: 里滕豪斯，无罪。

sentences.en: A jury has acquitted Kyle Rittenhouse on all five charges that he faced.
sentences.zh: 陪审团已裁定凯尔·里滕豪斯面临的所有五项指控均不成立。

sentences.en: My colleague, Julie Bosman, was at the courthouse in Kenosha, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我的同事朱莉·博斯曼当时在威斯康星州基诺沙的法院。

sentences.en: It's
sentences.zh: 现在是

sentences.en: Monday, November 22nd.
sentences.zh: 11月22日，星期一。

sentences.en: Julie, the last time we spoke with you, this trial had just gotten underway, and you had told us that Kyle Rittenhouse and his lawyers had a relatively strong case, given the
sentences.zh: 朱莉，我们上次和你通话时，审判才刚刚开始，你曾告诉我们，考虑到

sentences.en: trial's focus on self-defense.
sentences.zh: 审判的焦点在于正当防卫，凯尔·里滕豪斯和他的律师团队掌握着相对有力的辩护理由。

sentences.en: So just remind us why that was the thinking.
sentences.zh: 那么请提醒我们一下，当时为什么会有这种想法。

sentences.en: So I think for a lot of people, this case has been about a lot of different things.
sentences.zh: 我想对很多人来说，这个案件涉及很多不同的层面。

sentences.en: What people saw in the very beginning was the image of Kyle Rittenhouse, a white teenager who had brought a rifle to a protest that had grown out
sentences.zh: 人们最初看到的是凯尔·里滕豪斯的形象，一个白人少年带着一支步枪参加了一场抗议活动，这场活动源于

sentences.en: of a police shooting of a black man, Jacob Blake, by a white police officer.
sentences.zh: 一名白人警察枪击了一名黑人男子雅各布·布莱克。

sentences.en: They saw images and video of Kyle Rittenhouse walking down a city street carrying an AR-15 style rifle, and they learned
sentences.zh: 他们看到了凯尔·里滕豪斯走在城市街道上携带 AR-15 式步枪的图片和视频，并且得知

sentences.en: that he had shot and killed two people and shot and wounded a third man.
sentences.zh: 他开枪打死了两人，并打伤了第三个人。

sentences.en: All of the people who were shot were white, and two of them were unarmed.
sentences.zh: 所有被枪击的人都是白人，其中两人没有携带武器。

sentences.en: So these were the things that everyone in this country had immediately learned about Kyle Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是全国每个人最初了解到的关于凯尔·里滕豪斯的情况。

sentences.en: But when this trial started in Kenosha on November 1st, it was really just about one thing.
sentences.zh: 但当这场审判于 11 月 1 日在基诺沙开始时，它实际上只关乎一件事。

sentences.en: And that was, under Wisconsin state law, the question of self-defense.
sentences.zh: 那就是根据威斯康星州法律，关于正当防卫的问题。

sentences.en: Did Kyle Rittenhouse act in self-defense when he shot and killed two people and wounded another?
sentences.zh: 凯尔·里滕豪斯在开枪打死两人并打伤另一人时，是否属于正当防卫？

sentences.en: Did he reasonably fear for his life or fear that he would suffer great bodily harm when he fired those eight shots in Kenosha?
sentences.zh: 当他在基诺沙开出那八枪时，他是否合理地担心自己的生命安全，或者担心自己会遭受严重的身体伤害？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But there was uncertainty about exactly how the trial would unfold, about just how sympathetic
sentences.zh: 但对于审判将如何展开，以及陪审团对里滕豪斯及其正当防卫的辩护论点会有多同情，

sentences.en: the jury would be to Rittenhouse and to his argument of self-defense, and whether the prosecution could show that Rittenhouse shouldn't have feared for his life.
sentences.zh: 还有检方能否证明里滕豪斯不应该担心自己的生命安全，这些都存在不确定性。

sentences.en: And given that Rittenhouse was found not guilty on every single count, clearly the prosecution didn't accomplish that.
sentences.zh: 鉴于里滕豪斯在每一项指控上都被判无罪，显然检方并没有做到这一点。

sentences.en: So we want to talk to you about the key moments in this trial that explain why that was, why this trial ended up being such a complete victory for Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想和你谈谈这次审判中的关键时刻，解释为什么会这样，为什么这场审判最终成了里滕豪斯的彻底胜利。

sentences.en: Where should we start?
sentences.zh: 我们应该从哪里开始？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's proceed with the state's case.
sentences.zh: 让我们从检方的陈述开始。

sentences.en: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 早上好，女士们，先生们。

sentences.en: The evidence in this case will show that on the night of August 25th, 2020...
sentences.zh: 本案的证据将显示，在 2020 年 8 月 25 日晚上……

sentences.en: Well, a lot of the testimony that we heard over the three weeks of this trial centered on the three men that Kyle Rittenhouse shot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在为期三周的审判中听到的大部分证词都集中在凯尔·里滕豪斯枪击的那三个人身上。

sentences.en: And the first person who was shot was a 36-year-old named Joseph Rosenbaum.
sentences.zh: 第一个被枪击的人是一名 36 岁的男子，名叫约瑟夫·罗森鲍姆。

sentences.en: Tell us about that testimony.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那段证词。

sentences.en: So, in theory, Joseph Rosenbaum would have been a pretty challenging element for the defense lawyers.
sentences.zh: 理论上，约瑟夫·罗森鲍姆对辩护律师来说应该是一个相当棘手的因素。

sentences.en: He was seen carrying what looked like a kind of clear plastic bag throughout the evening.
sentences.zh: 整晚都有人看到他提着一个看起来像是透明塑料袋的东西。

sentences.en: He was five foot four.
sentences.zh: 他身高五英尺四英寸。

sentences.en: He was probably not there as a protester, but he came downtown for reasons that aren't clear.
sentences.zh: 他可能不是作为抗议者在那里的，但他来到市中心的原因并不清楚。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: Did you see him with any sort of weapon outside of that bag?
sentences.zh: 你有没有看到他除了那个袋子之外还携带任何武器？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: He was unarmed.
sentences.zh: 他没有携带武器。

sentences.en: No gun?
sentences.zh: 没有枪？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No knife?
sentences.zh: 没有刀？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No chain?
sentences.zh: 没有铁链？

sentences.en: So, throughout the trial, this was a point that the prosecutor made over and over from witness to witness.
sentences.zh: 所以，在整个审判过程中，这是检察官反复向每一位证人强调的一点。

sentences.en: Did you see him with a club or a bat of any...
sentences.zh: 你有没有看到他拿着棍子或球棒之类的……

sentences.en: That Joseph Rosenbaum was not armed with a gun that night.
sentences.zh: 即约瑟夫·罗森鲍姆那天晚上没有携带枪支。

sentences.en: Did you ever see a weapon on Mr. Rosenbaum?
sentences.zh: 你有没有在罗森鲍姆先生身上看到任何武器？

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: But as the trial went on, some witnesses began to offer testimony that painted Rosenbaum as a much more problematic figure for the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 但随着审判的进行，一些证人开始提供证词，将罗森鲍姆描绘成对检方来说更具问题的人物。

sentences.en: Please state your first and last name and spell them for the benefit of the court reporter.
sentences.zh: 请说明你的名字和姓氏，并为法庭记录员拼写出来。

sentences.en: Carrie Ann Swart.
sentences.zh: 凯莉·安·斯沃特。

sentences.en: It's spelled K.
sentences.zh: 拼写是 K。

sentences.en: This happened early on with one of the prosecution's witnesses, who was Joseph Rosenbaum's fiancée.
sentences.zh: 这种情况很早就发生在检方的一位证人身上，她是约瑟夫·罗森鲍姆的未婚妻。

sentences.en: And the prosecutor asked her in her testimony...
sentences.zh: 检察官在证词中问她……

sentences.en: Do you know if he was able to procure any medication that day?
sentences.zh: 你知道他那天是否能够买到任何药物吗？

sentences.en: ...if Rosenbaum had picked up his medication that day.
sentences.zh: ……罗森鲍姆那天是否取了他的药。

sentences.en: He was not able to fill the prescriptions he had because the Walgreens closest to us had been boarded up and closed down due to the chaos that was going on.
sentences.zh: 他没能配到他需要的处方药，因为离我们最近的沃尔格林药店因为当时发生的混乱而被封板关闭了。

sentences.en: Which then opened the door to a new line of questioning from the defense.
sentences.zh: 这随后为辩方开启了新的询问方向。

sentences.en: You had answered some questions from Maturnee Krauss regarding Joseph taking medications that day?
sentences.zh: 你回答了马图尼·克劳斯关于约瑟夫那天服用药物的一些问题？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Did you know what he took that for?
sentences.zh: 你知道他服用这些药是为了什么吗？

sentences.en: A bipolar disorder.
sentences.zh: 双相情感障碍。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Any other medications that you know that he took?
sentences.zh: 还有其他你知道他服用的药物吗？

sentences.en: I know he was on an antidepressant.
sentences.zh: 我知道他在服用抗抑郁药。

sentences.en: At that time, I don't know which one they had him on.
sentences.zh: 当时，我不知道他们让他服用的是哪一种。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And why does that matter?
sentences.zh: 为什么这很重要？

sentences.en: For the jury, I think that that gave them a piece of information that suggested that he was suffering from mental health issues and being treated for them.
sentences.zh: 对于陪审团来说，我认为这提供了一条信息，表明他患有心理健康问题并正在接受治疗。

sentences.en: So that created a question for the jury about Rosenbaum's state of mind.
sentences.zh: 这给陪审团留下了一个关于罗森鲍姆精神状态的问题。

sentences.en: This is a photo of Rosenbaum walking to the St. James lot that was under construction at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是一张罗森鲍姆走向当时正在施工的圣詹姆斯停车场的照片。

sentences.en: This is where, just before, he tips over a port-a-potty.
sentences.zh: 就在这之前，他掀翻了一个移动厕所。

sentences.en: And then, as testimony continued, we heard from witnesses who had seen Rosenbaum that evening.
sentences.zh: 随后，随着证词的继续，我们听到了那天晚上见过罗森鲍姆的证人的陈述。

sentences.en: At one point, he was starting a fire.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他在纵火。

sentences.en: Describe that.
sentences.zh: 描述一下那个场景。

sentences.en: People were tipping over port-a-potty and letting it on fire.
sentences.zh: 人们正在掀翻移动厕所并点火。

sentences.en: He was shouting at people.
sentences.zh: 他在对人们大喊大叫。

sentences.en: He was yelling, fuck the police, over and over and over.
sentences.zh: 他一遍又一遍地大喊，去他妈的警察。

sentences.en: I'm not afraid to go back to jail.
sentences.zh: 我不怕再进监狱。

sentences.en: And shoot me N-word.
sentences.zh: 朝我开枪啊，黑鬼。

sentences.en: Shoot me N-word.
sentences.zh: 朝我开枪啊，黑鬼。

sentences.en: And, you know, shouting racial epithets and scuffling with other people in front of a gas station.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他在加油站前大喊种族歧视的词汇并与其他人发生扭打。

sentences.en: Could you state your name for the record and spell your last name?
sentences.zh: 你能为了记录说明你的名字并拼写你的姓氏吗？

sentences.en: Richie McGinnis.
sentences.zh: 里奇·麦金尼斯。

sentences.en: R-I-C-H-I-E.
sentences.zh: R-I-C-H-I-E.

sentences.en: And then we heard from a really crucial witness named Richie McGinnis, who's the video director for the Daily Caller, a conservative site.
sentences.zh: 然后我们听取了一位非常关键的证人里奇·麦金尼斯的证词，他是保守派网站《每日传讯》的视频总监。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: I could hear a lot of yelling and I could see there was a crowd of people in the street and one individual, Mr. Rosenbaum, advancing towards Mr. Rittenhouse,
sentences.zh: 我能听到很多叫喊声，我能看到街上有一群人，其中一个人，罗森鲍姆先生，正向里滕豪斯先生冲过去，

sentences.en: as well as a couple of other individuals who were moving.
sentences.zh: 还有其他几个人也在移动。

sentences.en: And Richie McGinnis testified that he saw Rosenbaum chasing Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 里奇·麦金尼斯作证说他看到罗森鲍姆在追赶里滕豪斯。

sentences.en: There were a lot of screaMs.
sentences.zh: 有很多尖叫声。

sentences.en: You can hear in the video the friendly, friendly.
sentences.zh: 你可以在视频中听到“友好的，友好的”。

sentences.en: He saw Rittenhouse start to yell, friendly, friendly, in Rosenbaum's direction, meaning I'm not a threat to you.
sentences.zh: 他看到里滕豪斯开始朝罗森鲍姆的方向大喊“友好的，友好的”，意思是“我对你没有威胁”。

sentences.en: I'm friendly.
sentences.zh: 我是友好的。

sentences.en: Mr. Rosenbaum ran after him and I was behind both of them.
sentences.zh: 罗森鲍姆先生追着他跑，我就在他们两人身后。

sentences.en: And Richie McGinnis, who was the only person who was really standing close to them when the first shooting occurred,
sentences.zh: 里奇·麦金尼斯是第一次枪击发生时唯一真正站在他们附近的人，

sentences.en: testified that he saw Rosenbaum continue to chase Rittenhouse until Rittenhouse whirled around.
sentences.zh: 他作证说他看到罗森鲍姆一直追赶里滕豪斯，直到里滕豪斯猛地转身。

sentences.en: At this moment, when he stopped, it was aimed about 45 degrees at the ground.
sentences.zh: 就在他停下的那一刻，枪口大约向下倾斜了 45 度。

sentences.en: And he saw Rosenbaum lunge forward and.
sentences.zh: 他看到罗森鲍姆向前猛扑，并且。

sentences.en: When Mr. Rosenbaum lunged, Mr. Rittenhouse kind of dodged around.
sentences.zh: 当罗森鲍姆先生猛扑过来时，里滕豪斯先生侧身躲开了。

sentences.en: Reached for the barrel of the rifle.
sentences.zh: 伸手去抓步枪的枪管。

sentences.en: And then that's when it was leveled at Mr. Rosenbaum and fired.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，枪口对准了罗森鲍姆先生并开了火。

sentences.en: So all of this was very damaging to the state because the jury was starting to get a picture of Joseph Rosenbaum as someone who was behaving erratically and someone who posed a physical threat to Kyle Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切对检方来说非常不利，因为陪审团开始将约瑟夫·罗森鲍姆视为一个行为古怪且对凯尔·里滕豪斯构成身体威胁的人。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So what the jury would have absorbed here is testimony that Rosenbaum was mentally ill, perhaps unstable, behaving erratically, at times violently,
sentences.zh: 所以陪审团在这里吸收的信息是，罗森鲍姆患有精神疾病，可能不稳定，行为古怪，有时甚至暴力，

sentences.en: that he initiates an encounter with Rittenhouse in which he's chasing Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 他主动挑起了与里滕豪斯的冲突，并追赶里滕豪斯。

sentences.en: Rittenhouse is trying to convince Rosenbaum that he, Rittenhouse, is not a threat, but Rosenbaum persists and ultimately seems to grab after Rittenhouse's gun.
sentences.zh: 里滕豪斯试图让罗森鲍姆相信他（里滕豪斯）没有威胁，但罗森鲍姆坚持不懈，最终似乎试图去抢夺里滕豪斯的枪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the reason that this was so important is that from the beginning of this trial, the defense knew that if they could convince the jury that that was a justified shooting,
sentences.zh: 这之所以如此重要，是因为从审判一开始，辩方就知道如果他们能让陪审团相信那是一次正当的枪击，

sentences.en: then they would have a much better chance of convincing the jury that the other shootings were also justified.
sentences.zh: 那么他们就有更大的机会让陪审团相信其他几次枪击也是正当的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's turn to the next of those two shootings and the testimony around them.
sentences.zh: 让我们转向那两次枪击中的下一次，以及围绕它们的证词。

sentences.en: So the second person who was shot was a 26-year-old man named Anthony Huber.
sentences.zh: 第二个被枪击的人是一名 26 岁的男子，名叫安东尼·胡伯。

sentences.en: And Huber also would seem on the surface to be a real problem for Kyle Rittenhouse's defense.
sentences.zh: 胡伯表面上看起来也是凯尔·里滕豪斯辩护团队的一个大麻烦。

sentences.en: Like Joseph Rosenbaum, he was not carrying a gun that night.
sentences.zh: 像约瑟夫·罗森鲍姆一样，他那天晚上没有携带枪支。

sentences.en: Did Anthony Huber forfeit his life by trying to be a hero and stop an active shooter and protect others?
sentences.zh: 安东尼·胡伯是否因为试图成为英雄、阻止活跃枪手并保护他人而付出了生命的代价？

sentences.en: And the prosecution described Huber as a hero.
sentences.zh: 检方将胡伯描述为英雄。

sentences.en: Anthony Huber tries to grab the gun, actually does grab the defendant's gun, and tries to pull it away because he's trying to disarm an active shooter.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·胡伯试图抢夺枪支，实际上确实抓住了被告的枪，并试图将其夺走，因为他试图解除一名活跃枪手的武装。

sentences.en: He was holding his skateboard when the first shots rang out.
sentences.zh: 当第一声枪响时，他正拿着他的滑板。

sentences.en: He started running immediately as Kyle Rittenhouse was running down the street and people were shouting to get him,
sentences.zh: 当凯尔·里滕豪斯沿着街道奔跑时，他立即开始奔跑，人群中有人大喊抓住他，

sentences.en: that he was the shooter, that people in the crowd needed to tackle him.
sentences.zh: 说他是枪手，人群需要制服他。

sentences.en: And so Anthony Huber was one of the people who tried to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以安东尼·胡伯是试图这样做的人之一。

sentences.en: He caught up with Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 他追上了里滕豪斯。

sentences.en: He hit him on his head with his skateboard.
sentences.zh: 他用滑板击中了里滕豪斯的头部。

sentences.en: And Rittenhouse shot him once in the chest and killed him.
sentences.zh: 里滕豪斯朝他的胸部开了一枪，杀死了他。

sentences.en: So the potential problem for the defense here is that Huber is being described as a civic-minded person trying to stop a shooter from, I guess, shooting more people.
sentences.zh: 所以辩方在这里面临的潜在问题是，胡伯被描述为一个有公民意识的人，试图阻止枪手继续射击更多人。

sentences.en: And that could make a self-defense argument trickier.
sentences.zh: 这可能会使正当防卫的辩护变得更加棘手。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the defense then started to set up a counter-narrative.
sentences.zh: 于是辩方开始建立一种反叙事。

sentences.en: They started to make the case that Huber was actually a lethal threat to Kyle Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 他们开始主张胡伯实际上对凯尔·里滕豪斯构成了致命威胁。

sentences.en: Mr. Washington, we just saw an individual walk through the video carrying a skateboard.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿先生，我们刚才看到一个人拿着滑板走过视频画面。

sentences.en: Did you see that person?
sentences.zh: 你看到那个人了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 看到了。

sentences.en: Do you have any idea who that is?
sentences.zh: 你知道那是谁吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: One of the defense lawyers questioned a live streamer who testified.
sentences.zh: 辩方律师之一盘问了一位出庭作证的直播博主。

sentences.en: And this live streamer was there that night.
sentences.zh: 这位直播博主当晚就在现场。

sentences.en: He was taking video of what had happened.
sentences.zh: 他拍摄了当时发生的事情。

sentences.en: Mr. Huber has a skateboard.
sentences.zh: 胡伯先生拿着滑板。

sentences.en: On that particular night, did you have a skateboard?
sentences.zh: 在那个晚上，你带了滑板吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 带了。

sentences.en: And he happened to be a skateboarder.
sentences.zh: 而他恰好是个滑板手。

sentences.en: So the defense lawyer was asking the live streamer.
sentences.zh: 所以辩方律师在问那位直播博主。

sentences.en: If you were going to swing that skateboard in an effort to create some velocity and hurt someone, how would you swing it?
sentences.zh: 如果你打算挥动滑板来产生速度并伤害某人，你会怎么挥动它？

sentences.en: If I was going to swing my skateboard to hurt someone?
sentences.zh: 如果我要挥动滑板去伤害某人？

sentences.en: Could you inflict great harm on this person by using a skateboard?
sentences.zh: 使用滑板能对这个人造成严重伤害吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And as you have explained, in this case, the recurring question that matters, perhaps the only question that matters,
sentences.zh: 正如你所解释的，在本案中，那个反复出现且至关重要的问题，或许是唯一重要的问题，

sentences.en: is did Kyle Rittenhouse see each and every one of these people as a potentially lethal threat to him?
sentences.zh: 就是凯尔·里滕豪斯是否将这些人中的每一个都视为对他潜在的致命威胁？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the jury, again, has to go back to that basic question of how Kyle Rittenhouse is viewing the situation and how he viewed the threat that he had faced.
sentences.zh: 所以陪审团必须再次回到那个基本问题：凯尔·里滕豪斯是如何看待当时的情况，以及他如何看待自己所面临的威胁。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And whether Kyle Rittenhouse's view that night and his assessment of those threats was reasonable.
sentences.zh: 以及凯尔·里滕豪斯当晚的观点和他对这些威胁的评估是否合理。

sentences.en: That is the question, the very narrow question before the jury.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在，摆在陪审团面前的非常狭窄的问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what's interesting about that is that it means that the self-defense argument here doesn't really acknowledge the idea that somebody like Huber
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这意味着这里的正当防卫论点并没有真正承认像胡伯这样的人，

sentences.en: thinks that he's protecting the public from Rittenhouse and Rittenhouse's gun in this moment.
sentences.zh: 认为他在那一刻是在保护公众免受里滕豪斯及其枪支的伤害。

sentences.en: It only sees Huber's actions to disarm or to disable Rittenhouse as a threat to Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 它只将胡伯试图解除或制服里滕豪斯的行为视为对里滕豪斯的威胁。

sentences.en: Right, because Anthony Huber, of course, is not here to explain in a courtroom what he was thinking or feeling that night or how threatening he saw Kyle Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为安东尼·胡伯当然无法在法庭上解释他当晚的想法或感受，或者他认为凯尔·里滕豪斯有多大的威胁性。

sentences.en: That is a question that was not able to be answered.
sentences.zh: 这是一个无法回答的问题。

sentences.en: So at this point, we can see that the prosecution's case is starting to crumble a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以此时我们可以看到，检方的案子开始有点站不住脚了。

sentences.en: Yes, but the prosecution had another witness lined up, Gage Grosskreutz, who was a 26-year-old who was there that night,
sentences.zh: 是的，但检方还有另一位证人，盖奇·格罗斯克鲁茨，他是一位当晚在场的26岁年轻人，

sentences.en: and he was the third person who Kyle Rittenhouse shot that evening.
sentences.zh: 他也是凯尔·里滕豪斯当晚枪击的第三个人。

sentences.en: And unlike the other two people who were shot, Grosskreutz survived with a shot to the arm.
sentences.zh: 与另外两名被枪击的人不同，格罗斯克鲁茨手臂中弹后幸存了下来。

sentences.en: So he could describe what he was doing, what he was thinking, what he was feeling, what he saw that night.
sentences.zh: 所以他可以描述他当晚在做什么、在想什么、有什么感觉，以及他看到了什么。

sentences.en: And the question was, would that undermine the self-defense argument that Kyle Rittenhouse, his lawyers, had made so far?
sentences.zh: 问题是，这会削弱凯尔·里滕豪斯及其律师迄今为止提出的正当防卫论点吗？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《重构者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: All right, let's go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: They say calls gauge gross courts.
sentences.zh: 他们说是盖奇·格罗斯克鲁茨。

sentences.en: So, Julie, tell us about the testimony from this third person shot by Kyle Rittenhouse and the only one to survive, Grosskreutz,
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，告诉我们关于凯尔·里滕豪斯枪击的第三个人，也是唯一幸存者格罗斯克鲁茨的证词，

sentences.en: and where his testimony leaves Rittenhouse's case for self-defense.
sentences.zh: 以及他的证词对里滕豪斯的正当防卫辩护有什么影响。

sentences.en: So, like Anthony Huber, the prosecution had presented Grosskreutz as a heroic figure.
sentences.zh: 和安东尼·胡伯一样，检方将格罗斯克鲁茨塑造成了一个英雄人物。

sentences.en: I went to school to be an EMT basic.
sentences.zh: 我上学是为了成为一名基础急救员。

sentences.en: After completing that course, I then worked as a EMT on a private animal.
sentences.zh: 完成课程后，我曾在一家私人机构担任急救员。

sentences.en: Grosskreutz was a trained paramedic.
sentences.zh: 格罗斯克鲁茨是一名受过训练的护理人员。

sentences.en: He was a person who had attended a lot of protests in a capacity as a volunteer medic.
sentences.zh: 他曾以志愿医护人员的身份参加过许多抗议活动。

sentences.en: I'd heard these gunshots.
sentences.zh: 我听到了枪声。

sentences.en: And he testified that he heard the shots that had killed Rosenbaum.
sentences.zh: 他作证说他听到了杀死罗森鲍姆的枪声。

sentences.en: And then after seeing people running northbound and then hearing people yelling medic,
sentences.zh: 在看到人们向北跑并听到有人喊“医护”后，

sentences.en: I started running southbound towards what I presumed at the time to be the origin of the gunshots.
sentences.zh: 我开始向南跑，朝着我当时认为枪声传来的方向跑去。

sentences.en: And wanted to immediately go and help and see who had been shot and if he could render medical aid.
sentences.zh: 并想立即去帮忙，看看谁中弹了，以及他是否能提供医疗援助。

sentences.en: So, like Huber, a seemingly sympathetic character.
sentences.zh: 所以，和胡伯一样，是一个看起来很值得同情的角色。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But early on, the prosecution confronted one of the facts that made Gage Grosskreutz a pretty complicated witness.
sentences.zh: 但检方很早就面对了一个事实，这使得盖奇·格罗斯克鲁茨成为了一名相当复杂的证人。

sentences.en: Were you carrying any of your equipment with you?
sentences.zh: 你随身携带了任何装备吗？

sentences.en: I was.
sentences.zh: 带了。

sentences.en: Were you armed?
sentences.zh: 你携带武器了吗？

sentences.en: I was.
sentences.zh: 带了。

sentences.en: He acknowledged that he was carrying a gun that night as well.
sentences.zh: 他承认那天晚上他也带着一把枪。

sentences.en: It's keys, phone, wallet, gun.
sentences.zh: 就是钥匙、手机、钱包、枪。

sentences.en: Grosskreutz testified that he carried a gun very frequently.
sentences.zh: 格罗斯克鲁茨作证说他经常带枪。

sentences.en: I believe in the Second Amendment.
sentences.zh: 我相信宪法第二修正案。

sentences.en: I am for people's right to carry and bear arMs.
sentences.zh: 我支持人们拥有携带武器的权利。

sentences.en: And that night was no different than any other day.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上和任何其他日子没什么不同。

sentences.en: And it was framed as, look, this guy is just another supporter of the Second Amendment.
sentences.zh: 这被解读为：看，这家伙只是宪法第二修正案的又一个支持者。

sentences.en: And that's how he's exercising that right.
sentences.zh: 这就是他在行使那种权利的方式。

sentences.en: But in the context of what happened in Kenosha that night, it got a little more complex.
sentences.zh: 但在基诺沙当晚发生的事情背景下，情况变得复杂了一些。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, after I had turned around and started running in the same direction as the defendant.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在我转身开始朝着被告的方向跑之后。

sentences.en: Very quickly, he found himself in the middle of the street as Kyle Rittenhouse was fleeing.
sentences.zh: 很快，当凯尔·里滕豪斯逃跑时，他发现自己身处街道中央。

sentences.en: I had started hearing people saying, he just shot that guy.
sentences.zh: 我开始听到人们说，他刚刚射杀了那个人。

sentences.en: He just shot somebody.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚射杀了某人。

sentences.en: And people in the crowd were chasing Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 人群中的人们正在追赶里滕豪斯。

sentences.en: I had seen an individual use a skateboard to hit the defendant.
sentences.zh: 我看到一个人用滑板击打被告。

sentences.en: And then from there, I heard another shot.
sentences.zh: 然后从那里，我听到了另一声枪响。

sentences.en: Grosskreutz was only a few feet away when Rittenhouse shot and killed Anthony Huber.
sentences.zh: 里滕豪斯开枪打死安东尼·胡伯时，格罗斯克鲁茨就在几英尺外。

sentences.en: Did you witness him fire a shot into Mr. Huber's chest?
sentences.zh: 你亲眼看到他向胡伯先生的胸部开了一枪吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 看到了。

sentences.en: And at this point...
sentences.zh: 而此时……

sentences.en: In my right hand, I had my Glock pistol.
sentences.zh: 我的右手拿着我的格洛克手枪。

sentences.en: And in my left hand, I had my cell phone.
sentences.zh: 左手拿着我的手机。

sentences.en: Grosskreutz had reached behind him and pulled out his gun, which he was holding.
sentences.zh: 格罗斯克鲁茨伸手到背后掏出了他的枪，并握在手中。

sentences.en: And standing face to face with Kyle Rittenhouse, who is now on the ground and still holding his rifle.
sentences.zh: 他与凯尔·里滕豪斯面对面站着，后者当时倒在地上，手里仍然拿着步枪。

sentences.en: What was going through your mind?
sentences.zh: 你当时在想什么？

sentences.en: At this particular moment.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻。

sentences.en: That I was going to die?
sentences.zh: 我快要死了？

sentences.en: Let's continue the video for just a second, please.
sentences.zh: 请把视频继续播放一秒钟。

sentences.en: And then Grosskreutz testifies that he raises his arms in the air in a gesture of surrender.
sentences.zh: 然后格罗斯克鲁茨作证说，他举起双臂做出了投降的姿势。

sentences.en: Did you see the defendant do anything with his gun after you put your hands up?
sentences.zh: 在你举起手后，你看到被告用他的枪做了什么吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 看到了。

sentences.en: What did you see him do?
sentences.zh: 你看到他做了什么？

sentences.en: It's an action that's typically referred to as re-racking.
sentences.zh: 这是一种通常被称为“重新上膛”的动作。

sentences.en: And then he testifies that he sees Kyle Rittenhouse make some kind of motion with his rifle.
sentences.zh: 然后他作证说，他看到凯尔·里滕豪斯用他的步枪做了一些动作。

sentences.en: So after you raised your hands like this, you saw the defendant re-rack the weapon?
sentences.zh: 所以当你像这样举起手后，你看到被告重新上膛了武器？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What did you think was going to happen?
sentences.zh: 你认为会发生什么？

sentences.en: In my experiences and in my inference in that moment, for the defendant had pointed his weapon at me and I had put my hands in the air.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验和当时的推断，被告曾用武器指着我，而我举起了双手。

sentences.en: Re-racking the weapon, in my mind, meant that the defendant pulled the trigger while my hands were in the air, but the gun didn't fire.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，重新上膛意味着被告在我的手举在空中时扣动了扳机，但枪没有响。

sentences.en: So then by re-racking the weapon, I inferred that the defendant wasn't accepting my surrender.
sentences.zh: 所以通过重新上膛，我推断被告不接受我的投降。

sentences.en: Did you feel that he was going to point the gun and shoot at you again?
sentences.zh: 你当时觉得他会再次用枪指着你并向你开枪吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What did you do then?
sentences.zh: 那你当时做了什么？

sentences.en: So after the defendant had re-racked his weapon with the rifle still aimed at me, in that moment,
sentences.zh: 所以当被告在步枪仍然瞄准我的情况下重新上膛后，那一刻，

sentences.en: I felt that I had to do something to try and prevent myself from being killed or being shot or killed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我必须做点什么，试图阻止自己被杀、被枪击或死亡。

sentences.en: And this is where, on cross-examination, the defense turned this around in Rittenhouse's favor.
sentences.zh: 这就是在交叉盘问中，辩方将局面扭转为对里滕豪斯有利的地方。

sentences.en: So your hands are up.
sentences.zh: 所以你的手举着。

sentences.en: And at that point...
sentences.zh: 而在那一刻……

sentences.en: No, he is not.
sentences.zh: 不，他没有。

sentences.en: The defense lawyer who was questioning Grosskreutz asked him about this exact moment.
sentences.zh: 负责盘问格罗斯克鲁茨的辩方律师问了他关于这一确切时刻的情况。

sentences.en: You would agree at this point, you are dropping your hands, you are loading your front foot toward Mr. Rittenhouse at that point.
sentences.zh: 你会同意在这一点上，你正在放下双手，你的前脚正朝里滕豪斯先生迈进，对吧？

sentences.en: True?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And Grosskreutz says that he began moving toward Rittenhouse to stop him in what he said was a non-lethal way, presumably without having to shoot him.
sentences.zh: 格罗斯克鲁茨说，他开始向里滕豪斯移动以阻止他，他称这是以非致命的方式，大概是不必开枪的情况下。

sentences.en: At this point, you're holding a loaded, chambered Glock 27 in your right hand.
sentences.zh: 此时，你的右手拿着一把装满子弹、已上膛的格洛克27手枪。

sentences.en: Yes?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: That is correct, yes.
sentences.zh: 没错，是的。

sentences.en: Advancing.
sentences.zh: 正在前进。

sentences.en: Who is seated on his...
sentences.zh: 谁坐在他的……

sentences.en: That is correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The gun is pointed in the direction of Mr. Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 枪口指向里滕豪斯先生的方向。

sentences.en: Agree?
sentences.zh: 同意吗？

sentences.en: I'll give you a picture.
sentences.zh: 我给你看张照片。

sentences.en: And in a pretty powerful moment...
sentences.zh: 在一个非常有力的时刻……

sentences.en: Now, you'd agree your firearm at Mr. Rittenhouse?
sentences.zh: 现在，你同意你的枪口对着里滕豪斯先生吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The defense lawyer got Grosskreutz to admit that he was pointing his gun in Rittenhouse's direction.
sentences.zh: 辩方律师让格罗斯克鲁茨承认他当时正把枪指向里滕豪斯的方向。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, when you were standing three to five feet from him with your arms up in the air, he never fired.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你站在离他三到五英尺远的地方，双手举在空中时，他从未开枪。

sentences.en: It wasn't until you pointed your gun at him, advanced on him, hands down, pointed at him, that he fired.
sentences.zh: 直到你把枪指向他，向他推进，双手放下，指向他时，他才开枪。

sentences.en: So right now, instead of this image of Kyle Rittenhouse shooting at someone who was trying to render aid,
sentences.zh: 所以现在，凯尔·里滕豪斯向试图提供援助的人开枪的形象不见了，

sentences.en: we have an image of Kyle Rittenhouse on the ground and Gage Grosskreutz standing and two men pointing their guns at each other until Rittenhouse fires a single shot,
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是凯尔·里滕豪斯倒在地上，盖奇·格罗斯克鲁茨站着，两人用枪指着对方，直到里滕豪斯开了一枪，

sentences.en: which hits Grosskreutz in the right bicep.
sentences.zh: 这击中了格罗斯克罗伊茨的右二头肌。

sentences.en: So, we're just seeing that encounter slightly differently and in a way that I think became really problematic for the prosecution's case.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们只是对那次遭遇的看法略有不同，而且我认为这种看法对检方的案子来说变得非常棘手。

sentences.en: So, that's how these three key encounters in this case played out to the legal benefit of Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是本案中这三次关键遭遇如何演变成对里滕豪斯有利的法律结果的。

sentences.en: I'm curious, as somebody in the courtroom, Julie,
sentences.zh: 朱莉，作为在法庭现场的人，我很好奇，

sentences.en: did anything else in the trial seem to strengthen Rittenhouse's case and help explain how the jury gets to the point where it ultimately ended up?
sentences.zh: 庭审中还有什么其他内容似乎加强了里滕豪斯的辩护，并有助于解释陪审团最终是如何得出那个结论的？

sentences.en: I would point to Kyle Rittenhouse's testimony.
sentences.zh: 我会指出凯尔·里滕豪斯的证词。

sentences.en: Could you please state your name, spell and your last name for the record?
sentences.zh: 请为了记录在案，说明你的姓名，并拼写你的姓氏好吗？

sentences.en: Kyle Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 凯尔·里滕豪斯。

sentences.en: R-I-T-T-E-N.
sentences.zh: R-I-T-T-E-N.

sentences.en: I think that the central question of this case was his self-defense argument.
sentences.zh: 我认为本案的核心问题是他的正当防卫辩护。

sentences.en: If his defense hinged on that question, and the fact that he was saying that his life was in danger, only Kyle Rittenhouse could effectively make that case to the jury.
sentences.zh: 如果他的辩护完全取决于这个问题，以及他声称自己生命受到威胁的事实，那么只有凯尔·里滕豪斯本人才能有效地向陪审团陈述这一理由。

sentences.en: Me and Ryan Balch were a little bit north, towards the north corner of 59th and Sheridan, and Mr. Rosenbaum was walking and...
sentences.zh: 我和瑞安·巴尔奇在北边一点，靠近第59街和谢里丹街的北角，罗森鲍姆先生当时正在走，然后……

sentences.en: So not long into his testimony, Rittenhouse's lawyer began asking him about what had led up to the shooting of Joseph Rosenbaum.
sentences.zh: 所以，在证词开始没多久，里滕豪斯的律师就开始问他导致枪击约瑟夫·罗森鲍姆事件的前因后果。

sentences.en: Describe what happened.
sentences.zh: 描述一下发生了什么。

sentences.en: I, once I take that step back, I look over my shoulder, and Mr. Rosenbaum, Mr. Rosenbaum was now running from my right side, and I was cornered from,
sentences.zh: 我，一旦我退后那一步，我回头看，罗森鲍姆先生，罗森鲍姆先生现在正从我的右侧跑过来，我被困住了，

sentences.en: in front of me with Mr. Zeminski, and there were...
sentences.zh: 在我前面有泽明斯基先生，还有……

sentences.en: And as Rittenhouse started to get into details about what had happened, he began sobbing, he was almost gasping for air.
sentences.zh: 当里滕豪斯开始详细讲述发生的事情时，他开始啜泣，几乎喘不过气来。

sentences.en: You can just relax for a minute, sir.
sentences.zh: 你可以先放松一下，先生。

sentences.en: We're going to take a break, about 10 minutes, and please don't talk about...
sentences.zh: 我们要休息一下，大约10分钟，请不要谈论……

sentences.en: And the judge very quickly called a recess so that Rittenhouse could compose himself and get back to testimony.
sentences.zh: 法官很快宣布休庭，以便里滕豪斯能平复情绪，回到证人席。

sentences.en: And what do you think that would have represented to the jury, as they thought about this self-defense case and his state of mind?
sentences.zh: 你认为这对陪审团意味着什么？当他们思考这个正当防卫案件和他的心理状态时？

sentences.en: You know, they were trying to emphasize his youth, and they were trying to get across the point that he was scared that night,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们试图强调他的年轻，并试图传达他那天晚上很害怕的观点，

sentences.en: which, of course, goes back and supports his self-defense claim.
sentences.zh: 这当然回过头来支持了他的正当防卫主张。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You came to Kenosha that night armed with the AR-15 and no other ways to physically defend yourself, correct?
sentences.zh: 你那天晚上带着AR-15来到基诺沙，没有其他身体防卫手段，对吧？

sentences.en: I had an AR-15, yes.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一把AR-15。

sentences.en: And other than that, he was pretty composed throughout most of his testimony.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他在大部分证词中都表现得相当镇定。

sentences.en: Why do you need the gun when you go out there?
sentences.zh: 你出去的时候为什么要带枪？

sentences.en: I need the gun because if I had to protect myself because somebody attacked me, why would you think anybody would do that?
sentences.zh: 我需要枪，因为如果我必须保护自己，因为有人攻击我，你为什么会认为有人会那样做？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But you clearly planned on it.
sentences.zh: 但你显然是有计划的。

sentences.en: You were prepared for it.
sentences.zh: 你为此做了准备。

sentences.en: You thought it was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 你认为这会发生。

sentences.en: No, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: That's the whole reason you brought the gun, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就是你带枪的全部原因，不是吗？

sentences.en: I brought the gun to protect myself.
sentences.zh: 我带枪是为了保护自己。

sentences.en: And during the cross-examination, the prosecutor questioned his decision to bring his gun downtown.
sentences.zh: 在交叉询问期间，检察官质疑了他带枪去市中心的决定。

sentences.en: They had questioned his motivations.
sentences.zh: 他们质疑了他的动机。

sentences.en: I don't understand.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: You said you're going to bring the gun to protect yourself.
sentences.zh: 你说你要带枪保护自己。

sentences.en: So you thought you were going to be in danger, right?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为你会处于危险之中，对吧？

sentences.en: I didn't think I would be put into a situation where I would have to defend myself.
sentences.zh: 我没想过我会陷入必须自卫的境地。

sentences.en: But Rittenhouse was a pretty consistent witness.
sentences.zh: 但里滕豪斯是一个相当一致的证人。

sentences.en: Everybody that you shot at that night, you intended to kill, correct?
sentences.zh: 你那天晚上射击的每一个人，你都打算杀死他们，对吧？

sentences.en: I didn't intend to kill them.
sentences.zh: 我没打算杀死他们。

sentences.en: I intended to stop the people who were attacking me.
sentences.zh: 我打算阻止那些攻击我的人。

sentences.en: By killing them?
sentences.zh: 通过杀死他们？

sentences.en: I did what I had to do to stop the person who was attacking me.
sentences.zh: 我做了我必须做的事来阻止攻击我的人。

sentences.en: He kept sticking to his story that he was just trying to defend himself in the moment.
sentences.zh: 他坚持自己的说法，即他当时只是试图自卫。

sentences.en: And that if he hadn't killed Rosenbaum, that Rosenbaum would have taken his gun and perhaps killed other people with it, along with Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 如果他不杀死罗森鲍姆，罗森鲍姆就会夺走他的枪，并可能用它杀死其他人，连同里滕豪斯一起。

sentences.en: So the final element of this trial is the gun itself, the one Rittenhouse used in these three shootings.
sentences.zh: 所以这次审判的最后一个要素是枪本身，也就是里滕豪斯在三次枪击事件中使用的那把枪。

sentences.en: And Julie, you had told us in our last conversation that because Carl Rittenhouse was 17 when all this happened,
sentences.zh: 朱莉，你在上次谈话中告诉我们，因为卡尔·里滕豪斯在这一切发生时只有17岁，

sentences.en: it was possible that his possession of that gun on that night might be considered illegal and that could color the entire trial in a way that was bad for Rittenhouse.
sentences.zh: 他那天晚上持有那把枪可能被视为非法，这可能会以对里滕豪斯不利的方式影响整个审判。

sentences.en: So what ended up happening with that in this case?
sentences.zh: 那么这件事最终结果如何？

sentences.en: So this is another thing that went the defense's way in the trial.
sentences.zh: 这是审判中另一件对辩方有利的事情。

sentences.en: So at the very beginning, the defense tried to knock out this illegal gun possession charge.
sentences.zh: 在最开始，辩方试图驳回非法持枪指控。

sentences.en: And this was a charge that because he was not 18, he was too young to possess this gun.
sentences.zh: 这是一项指控，因为他未满18岁，年龄太小，不能持有这把枪。

sentences.en: And the defense had made an argument that Kyle Rittenhouse actually did not violate the statute because of the length of his rifle.
sentences.zh: 辩方辩称，由于步枪的长度，凯尔·里滕豪斯实际上并没有违反法规。

sentences.en: And near the end of the trial, the judge, in a surprise, did throw out that gun possession charge.
sentences.zh: 在审判快结束时，法官令人惊讶地驳回了那项持枪指控。

sentences.en: So when the jury entered their deliberations, the gun possession charge was no longer something that they could consider.
sentences.zh: 所以当陪审团开始审议时，持枪指控已不再是他们可以考虑的问题了。

sentences.en: What do we now know about the jury's deliberations?
sentences.zh: 我们现在对陪审团的审议了解多少？

sentences.en: Well, one thing that was really striking about the deliberations is just how long they took.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于审议有一点非常引人注目，那就是他们花了多长时间。

sentences.en: The jury deliberated for three and a half days.
sentences.zh: 陪审团审议了三天半。

sentences.en: At one point, they asked if they could re-watch videos that portrayed each of the three shootings.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他们询问是否可以重看描绘这三次枪击事件的视频。

sentences.en: One day, one of the jurors asked if she could bring the jury instructions home with her.
sentences.zh: 有一天，其中一名陪审员问她是否可以把陪审团指示带回家。

sentences.en: This was 36 pages of, you know, very dense, very hard to understand instructions.
sentences.zh: 这是36页的，你知道，非常密集、非常难懂的指示。

sentences.en: And the judge said that he would allow her to do that, even though that was a pretty unusual requeSt.
sentences.zh: 法官说他会允许她这样做，尽管这是一个非常不寻常的请求。

sentences.en: Of course, in the end, the jurors were agreed that it was a full acquittal.
sentences.zh: 当然，最终陪审员们一致认为这是完全无罪释放。

sentences.en: And they all left the courthouse that day without stopping to speak to any reporters.
sentences.zh: 他们那天离开法院时没有停下来与任何记者交谈。

sentences.en: So it's hard to get clarity into what their discussions were like at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以目前很难清楚他们的讨论是什么样的。

sentences.en: But it is clear that the jury was really wrestling with the complexity of this case and the complexity of each of those five counts.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，陪审团确实在努力应对这个案件的复杂性以及这五项指控中每一项的复杂性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it seems that the rest of the country is still wrestling with the complexity of this case.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎全国其他地区仍在努力应对这个案件的复杂性。

sentences.en: Well, I think that since this case began, people have been looking at Kyle Rittenhouse, the individual.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为自从这个案件开始以来，人们一直在关注凯尔·里滕豪斯这个人。

sentences.en: There has been so much focus on who he is, what he believes, what he was thinking, you know, what his motivations were.
sentences.zh: 人们非常关注他是谁，他相信什么，他在想什么，你知道，他的动机是什么。

sentences.en: But I think that what this verdict shows is that this case is about something much bigger than just one person.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这个判决表明，这个案件关乎比一个人大得多的事情。

sentences.en: I think this really shows us that self-defense laws are colliding with another set of laws, with open carry laws.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实向我们表明，正当防卫法正在与另一套法律，即公开携带武器法发生冲突。

sentences.en: In dozens of states, it is legal to openly carry a firearm in public.
sentences.zh: 在几十个州，在公共场合公开携带枪支是合法的。

sentences.en: And I think that the self-defense laws that are on the books tended to spring from a different era where people kept guns at home.
sentences.zh: 我认为现有的正当防卫法往往源于一个不同的时代，那时人们把枪放在家里。

sentences.en: But now open carry, like in Wisconsin, allows people to bring guns into public places.
sentences.zh: 但现在公开携带武器，就像在威斯康星州一样，允许人们把枪带到公共场所。

sentences.en: You can bring your gun to the grocery store or to a crowded demonstration.
sentences.zh: 你可以把枪带到杂货店或拥挤的示威活动中。

sentences.en: So to focus on Kyle Rittenhouse, the person, feels to me like it's missing the larger point of this case.
sentences.zh: 所以关注凯尔·里滕豪斯这个人，在我看来就像是错过了这个案件的重点。

sentences.en: We are now at a moment where someone can bring a gun into a public place, shoot someone, maybe even kill them,
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于这样一个时刻，有人可以把枪带到公共场所，射击某人，甚至可能杀死他们，

sentences.en: and still mount a successful self-defense case because that person felt threatened by the other.
sentences.zh: 并且仍然可以成功进行正当防卫辩护，因为那个人感到受到了对方的威胁。

sentences.en: So whether you like it or not, the reality is that this is where our gun laws and our self-defense laws have brought us.
sentences.zh: 所以无论你喜欢与否，现实是这就是我们的枪支法和正当防卫法把我们带到的地方。

sentences.en: Thank you, Julie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，朱莉。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 这是你还需要知道的另一天的新闻。

sentences.en: On this vote, the yeas are 220, the nays are 213, the Build Back Better bill is passed.
sentences.zh: 投票结果为赞成220票，反对213票，《重建美好法案》获得通过。

sentences.en: After passing in the House of Representatives on Friday, President Biden's $2 trillion climate and social spending bill is now in the hands of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在周五众议院通过后，拜登总统的2万亿美元气候和社会支出法案现在交到了美国参议院手中。

sentences.en: Senate.
sentences.zh: 参议院。

sentences.en: The bill would, among other things, cap the cost of child care, provide paid family and medical leave for workers, and tax-polluting industries.
sentences.zh: 该法案除其他事项外，将限制儿童保育成本，为工人提供带薪家庭和医疗假，并对污染行业征税。

sentences.en: Its future in the evenly split Senate is uncertain, given the objections of two moderates, Senators Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema.
sentences.zh: 鉴于两位温和派参议员乔·曼钦和克里斯滕·西内马的反对，它在势均力敌的参议院的未来是不确定的。

sentences.en: But on Sunday, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer predicted the Senate would pass the bill by Christmas.
sentences.zh: 但在周日，参议院多数党领袖查克·舒默预测参议院将在圣诞节前通过该法案。

sentences.en: Look, everyone knows the House did a very strong bill.
sentences.zh: 看，每个人都知道众议院通过了一项非常强有力的法案。

sentences.en: Everyone knows that Manchin and Sinema have their concerns.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道曼钦和西内马有他们的顾虑。

sentences.en: But we're going to try to negotiate with them and get a very strong, bold bill out of the Senate, which will then go back to the House and pass.
sentences.zh: 但我们将尝试与他们谈判，并从参议院拿出一项非常强有力、大胆的法案，然后它将回到众议院并获得通过。

sentences.en: And police in the city of Waukesha, Wisconsin, said that multiple people, including children,
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州沃基肖市的警方表示，周日下午，一辆SUV的司机冲进聚集在节日游行的人群中，

sentences.en: were killed and injured on Sunday afternoon when the driver of an SUV plowed into crowds gathered for a holiday parade.
sentences.zh: 造成多人死亡和受伤，其中包括儿童。

sentences.en: The police said that a person of interest was in custody, but offered no information about a possible motive.
sentences.zh: 警方表示，一名相关人员已被拘留，但没有提供关于可能动机的信息。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由丹尼尔·吉梅特和克莱尔·坦尼斯盖特制作，亚历山大·李·杨提供了帮助。

sentences.zh: 原创音乐由丹·鲍威尔和玛丽安·洛萨诺创作。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴尔。

sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要完全黑暗才能睡觉的人吗？

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
